lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Three parallel horizontal rows of high-luminance circular clusters exhibiting regular inter-blob spacing across the lateral mid-section of the visible flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal spot rows, creating a structured lattice pattern visible primarily in the mid-flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges along the upper flank characterized by a high-contrast transition from high-luminance superior surfaces to shadowed inferior surfaces.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of small, low-intensity high-luminance blobs concentrated primarily within the posterior half of the first dorsal fin's silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular notch on the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin; horizontal white linear mark on the dorsal ridge posterior to the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Partial silhouette of a second dorsal fin posterior to the first; remora attached to the ventral-lateral region.
